chunks: “Because what comes out of the woman is the man’s fluid.” Then he said: “And the junub, when he immerses himself in water, one single immersion suffices for his purification.” This indicates that.

key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the context of discharge mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ: the man’s fluid, referring to seminal fluid in legal context

ai.seo_question: Does one full immersion in water suffice for ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This passage states a legal ruling related to janabah and purification. It indicates that for a person in a state of janabah, a single complete immersion in water suffices for taharah.
